title: Monodromy action of mirror stops for toric Calabi-Yau surfaces
summary: Mirror symmetry predicts an action by the fundamental group of a conjectural stringy Kähler moduli space on the derived category of an algebraic variety. For a toric variety, a model for this space is understood, but constructing the action is still an open problem in general. We propose that this action can be studied on the $A$-side via a moduli space of Legendrians isotopic to the FLTZ Legendrian.
